name: green-button
label: Green Button / ESPI
description: Energy consumption data standard — all US utilities must provide Green Button data

table_notes.gb_usage_point: Represents a single metered service location (e.g. a home or business) with its utility account and tariff context.
table_notes.gb_meter_reading: Captures the reading configuration for a meter at a usage point, including unit of measure and sampling interval.
table_notes.gb_interval_block: Groups a contiguous time-series window of interval readings delivered in a single ESPI data feed batch.
table_notes.gb_interval_reading: Individual energy measurement sample within an interval block; the leaf-level fact table for consumption analysis.

gb_usage_point.name: id
gb_usage_point.description: Internal surrogate key for the usage point

gb_usage_point.name: local_id
gb_usage_point.description: Utility-assigned identifier for this service point (stable across feeds)

gb_usage_point.name: customer_id
gb_usage_point.description: Utility account or customer number that owns this service point

gb_usage_point.name: service_category
gb_usage_point.description: ESPI service category code: electricity, gas, water, or time (ESPI ServiceKind enumeration)

gb_usage_point.name: meter_type
gb_usage_point.description: Physical meter classification (e.g. AMI smart meter, AMR, analog); informs data availability

gb_usage_point.name: service_address
gb_usage_point.description: Street address of the metered premises for geographic lookup and customer display

gb_usage_point.name: utility_name
gb_usage_point.description: Name of the utility company supplying service at this point

gb_usage_point.name: tariff_profile
gb_usage_point.description: Rate schedule or tariff code under which this usage point is billed (e.g. E-TOU-C)

gb_meter_reading.name: id
gb_meter_reading.description: Internal surrogate key for this reading configuration

gb_meter_reading.name: usage_point_id
gb_meter_reading.description: References gb_usage_point.id; the service location this reading belongs to

gb_meter_reading.name: reading_type
gb_meter_reading.description: ESPI ReadingType descriptor (e.g. net consumption, net generation, demand); distinguishes import vs export

gb_meter_reading.name: uom
gb_meter_reading.description: Unit of measure code per ESPI UnitSymbol: Wh, W, m3, ft3, therm, etc.

gb_meter_reading.name: power_of_ten_multiplier
gb_meter_reading.description: Scale factor: raw value × 10^n gives the actual quantity (e.g. -3 = milli, 3 = kilo)

gb_meter_reading.name: interval_length_seconds
gb_meter_reading.description: Duration of each individual reading sample in seconds (typically 900 for 15-min, 3600 for hourly)

gb_meter_reading.name: accumulation_behaviour
gb_meter_reading.description: ESPI AccumulationKind: deltaData (interval energy), summation (cumulative register), etc.

gb_interval_block.name: id
gb_interval_block.description: Internal surrogate key for this interval block

gb_interval_block.name: meter_reading_id
gb_interval_block.description: References gb_meter_reading.id; the reading configuration this block belongs to

gb_interval_block.name: start_at
gb_interval_block.description: UTC timestamp of the first interval in this block (wall-clock start of delivery window)

gb_interval_block.name: duration_seconds
gb_interval_block.description: Total wall-clock span of the block in seconds (sum of all contained interval durations)

gb_interval_block.name: num_readings
gb_interval_block.description: Expected count of interval readings in this block; use to detect incomplete feeds

gb_interval_reading.name: id
gb_interval_reading.description: Auto-incrementing surrogate key; BIGSERIAL supports high-volume 15-min meter feeds

gb_interval_reading.name: interval_block_id
gb_interval_reading.description: References gb_interval_block.id; the delivery batch this reading was part of

gb_interval_reading.name: start_at
gb_interval_reading.description: UTC start of this specific measurement interval (index for time-series queries)

gb_interval_reading.name: duration_seconds
gb_interval_reading.description: Duration of this individual sample in seconds (matches meter_reading.interval_length_seconds)

gb_interval_reading.name: value
gb_interval_reading.description: Raw measured quantity; apply power_of_ten_multiplier from gb_meter_reading to get physical units

gb_interval_reading.name: quality_of_reading
gb_interval_reading.description: ESPI QualityOfReading code: valid, estimated, projected, questionable, derived, etc.

short_description: Energy consumption data standard — all US utilities must provide Green Button data
long_description: Green Button / ESPI (Energy Services Provider Interface) is the US standard for consumer energy data access, mandated under Smart Grid Investment Grant programs. The schema captures utility account data, meter reading configurations, interval data blocks, and individual interval readings — enabling analysis of energy consumption patterns.
when_to_use: Use for energy analytics tools, smart home energy management apps, demand response platforms, or any consumer energy application. All US utilities receiving Smart Grid Investment Grants must provide Green Button data. Over 65 million US homes have Green Button access. Required for participation in US demand response programs and some state utility API mandates.
